summary: P0 regression + all listed frontend flows validated over the live preview URL after backend Mongo-migration refactor. Duo-vs-AI end-to-end (tester1 host invites Tester2, Tester2 accepts from notifications bell): BOTH clients land in the SAME /game/{game_id} route (e.g. g_5b79ea19f0f5). NO 'Partie introuvable' text on host. Solo vs AI, private room (create -> sit seat 0 -> start-game-button -> /game/*), matchmaking queue (waiting + leave), tutorial listing (14 lessons), notifications bell, and rejoin banner (resume-game-banner + resume-game-button) all work. React Native web-only console warnings still emitted but non-blocking (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — coming from RN 0.79 web deprecation, still present. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow helper) and any component using shadowColor/shadowRadius/etc.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — persists app-wide. Migrate JSX prop to style.pointerEvents.

Console warnings: '[Reanimated] Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' — emitted repeatedly during matchmaking screen shuffle animation (matchmaking.tsx uses Easing.inOut(Easing.quad) inside withRepeat/withSequence). Not blocking, but consider gating with Platform.OS !== 'web'.

Console error: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' — happens on the tutorial route entry and during matchmaking on web. Likely a style being spread with a kebab-case key (or a Reanimated animation param). Reference: likely /app/frontend/app/matchmaking.tsx (ShufflingCard) or /app/frontend/app/tutorial/index.tsx.

action_items: Optional: fix invalid DOM style key 'transform-origin' -> use camelCase 'transformOrigin' (likely in matchmaking.tsx ShufflingCard or tutorial screen intro animation).
Optional: silence 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings by migrating to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents (RN 0.79 web).
Optional: guard non-linear easings (Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)) with Platform.OS !== 'web' or accept the linear fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: P0 fix confirmed at runtime: no 'Partie introuvable' on host after Tester2 accepts duo-vs-AI invite. game_id polled from /matchmaking/status on host and accept response on guest both return the same id from the Mongo-backed live_games — cross-worker routing is fine.

home.tsx acceptDuoInvite() correctly branches on res.game_id vs res.status (vs_ai returns game_id immediately, online returns queued state). Matchmaking screen (matchmaking.tsx) correctly listens for status==='found' + game_id via polling and does router.replace to /game/[id]. No changes needed.
